name: zvideo_dd_image_populate_surface_from_heap_pixels
description: zVideo_dd::Image_PopulateSurfaceFromHeapPixels locks an image-owned DirectDrawSurface3, copies heap pixels row by row into the locked surface, frees and rebinds image pixels to surface memory, stores pitchWords, and unlocks with lost-surface retry handling.
known_limits: VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison currently fails with 287 unmasked mismatches after 23 relocation bytes and 11 trimmed VC NOPs; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DirectDraw image/surface source-cluster pass.
A full DDSURFACEDESC memset plus dwSize store preserved behavior but worsened the compare to 292 unmasked mismatches, so the source body was restored.
A dwFlags-tail memset plus dwSize store preserved behavior but was byte-neutral at 290 unmasked mismatches, so the source body was restored.

Explicit C retry labels preserved behavior and improved the compare from the previous 290-mismatch baseline, but DirectDraw Lock/Unlock lost-surface retry call scheduling, descriptor dwSize store scheduling, row-copy local scheduling, and descriptor/pitch-store ordering drift remain.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a8500 validates fastcall ECX=image, DDSURFACEDESC size 0x6c setup, IDirectDrawSurface3::Lock through provider vtable offset 0x64 with null rect, DDLOCK_WAIT, and null event, DDERR_SURFACELOST Restore through offset 0x6c and retry, ReportError lines 0x31b and 0x31f for lock/restore failures, row copies using signed image width shifted left one byte, free(image->pixels), image->pixels rebinding to lockedSurfaceDesc.lpSurface, image->pitchWords = lPitch >> 1, Unlock through offset 0x80 with the descriptor pointer, DDERR_SURFACELOST Restore/retry, ReportError lines 0x33b and 0x33f, and return 1 only after Unlock succeeds.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a8500 has no warnings and matches the source lock loop, restore retry behavior, row-copy loop, heap-pixel ownership transfer, pitch update, and unlock loop.

The native smoke installs a fake DirectDrawSurface3 provider table and verifies the successful lock/copy/free/rebind/unlock path, row pitch gap preservation, locked descriptor size and arguments, lost-surface lock retry through Restore, and a non-lost lock failure returning 0 without freeing or rebinding the heap pixel pointer.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a8500 failed under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs with 287 unmasked mismatches after 23 relocation-masked bytes and 11 trimmed VC NOP bytes; BN size is 332 and VC5 size is 368. Evidence: build/vc5-verify/zvideo_dd_image_populate_surface_from_heap_pixels/verify/4a8500_byte_diff.txt and 4a8500_asm_classified_diff.txt. The remaining drift is DirectDraw Lock/Unlock lost-surface retry call scheduling, descriptor dwSize store scheduling, row-copy local scheduling, and descriptor/pitch-store ordering; behavior target still passes.
